name: Ethiopian National Defense Force (ENDF) — Regular Army
detail: Federal army under Field Marshal Birhanu Jula's command; deployed a reported ~20,000 troops to South Gondar in March 2026 and engaged TPLF forces at Shererina in August 2026.

name: ENDF Armed Drone Fleet (incl. reported Turkish-made systems)
detail: Used extensively in aerial operations against Fano positions in Amhara and reportedly against TPLF-linked sites in Tigray, including the disputed August 10, 2026 Merewa Secondary School strike attributed to a Turkish-made platform.

name: Amhara-Aligned Militias
detail: Militia forces supporting federal operations in contested Tigray-Amhara boundary areas including Tselemt, distinct from the anti-government Fano insurgency despite shared regional identity.

name: Tigray Defense Forces (TDF)
detail: TPLF-aligned regional force retained weapons and territorial positions after the 2022 Pretoria agreement; crossed the Tekeze River into Tselemt in January 2026 and engaged ENDF at Shererina in August.

name: TPLF 'Army 70' Unit
detail: TPLF combat unit reportedly based across the border in Sudan; identified by regional analysts as involved in the August 1, 2026 Shererina engagement with federal forces.

name: Amhara Fano National Movement (AFNM)
detail: Unified Fano command structure established January 17, 2026 under chairman Zemene Kassie and military commander Brig. Gen. Tefera Mamo, consolidating previously fragmented militia factions across Amhara zones.

name: Oromo Liberation Army (OLA)
detail: Insurgent group commanded by Kumsa Diriba ('Jaal Marroo'), operating across Oromia including areas within ~100km of Addis Ababa; claimed a major operation in March 2026 and was linked to the East Arsi Zone violence around the June election.

name: Eritrean Defense Forces
detail: Eritrea's military under President Isaias Afwerki maintained heightened readiness along the northern border amid 2026 rhetoric warning of Ethiopian war preparations tied to Red Sea access.

name: Tigray Peace Force
detail: Federally-aligned regional security structure created under the Pretoria agreement to support the Tigray Interim Administration; its role became contested after the TPLF's May 2026 reconstitution of a rival regional council.

name: Ethiopian Air Force (ETAF)
detail: Conducted overhead maneuvers near Mekelle around the May 4, 2026 explosion incident and remains a key federal asset in the aerial campaign against Fano and TPLF-aligned positions.
